## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> List this writer's published Substack posts, newest first, with title, subtitle, date, free or paid audience, likes, comments, word count, url and a short preview. Pass publicationId from list_my_newsletters to limit it to one newsletter, and audience to get only free or only paid posts. hasRecordingTranscript is true when the post has a live, video or podcast recording whose transcript get_my_posts returns with includeTranscripts: true. These are published posts, not WriteStack article drafts (use list_articles for those).

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `audience` | `string` | No | everyone for free posts, only_paid for paywalled posts One of: `"everyone"`, `"only_paid"`. |
| `limit` | `integer` | No | Max posts to return, newest first (default 15, max 30) Min 1. Max 30. Default `15`. |
| `publicationId` | `integer` | No | Limit to one newsletter. Use a publicationId from list_my_newsletters. |
